exclusions.boundaryReason: Technical runtime validation context; never user-visible UI copy.
No translation or copy rewrite without product/API decision.

exclusions.sourceCategory: Course titles/descriptions, instructor names, chat messages and user profile values
exclusions.boundaryReason: Do not translate user content in the frontend.

exclusions.sourceCategory: Routes, API paths, storage keys, CSS selectors, event keys, DOM identifiers and diagnostics
exclusions.boundaryReason: Identifiers remain unchanged; only their user-visible safe wrappers belong in Corpus.
Detector rejects router action enums and strings with no human-language characters; they are navigation control flow, not copy.
Detector rejects lower-camel callback/query identifiers, DOM tag constants and control-flow expressions.

Only visible UI literals/templates and aria/alt/VisuallyHidden assistive copy may enter Corpus. Source metadata stays in Source / screen; code identifiers, dotted parser/function fragments, input configuration, punctuation and JSX/parser fragments are rejected.

exclusions.sourceCategory: SessionProvider, LocaleProvider, ThemeProvider, CourseChatLauncher; AppShell SVG path; RouteErrorBoundary title template; PDF/cart/sort/delete/pagination dynamic templates
exclusions.boundaryReason: Provider/context diagnostics, cache keys, CSS/SVG and developer text are excluded. Genuine UI/a11y templates are retained only with complete named placeholders.

exclusions.sourceCategory: 486 source occurrences audited into 346 translation units
exclusions.origin: DRAFT-11 semantic deduplication and presentation-class audit
exclusions.boundaryReason: Exact case-sensitive English duplicates are merged only when meaning and classification match. Visible and accessibility-only uses remain separate; multiline VisuallyHidden content is classified as assistive copy; capitalization variants preserve immutable English; all source occurrences remain on Occurrences.

exclusions.sourceCategory: MLUX004-D04 residual-source audit outside the 16 listed supplemental occurrences
exclusions.boundaryReason: D04 is bounded to its explicit frontend-owned occurrences; instructor/admin, route lifecycle, backend and user content remain out of scope.

Only this exact visible LearnHub wordmark is locale-invariant. Its LearnHub home accessibility label is localized through MLUX-C0373; no path, substring, regex or broad English allowlist is authorized.

exclusions.boundaryReason: AppRouter.pageForRoute handles every current APP_ROUTES ID with a concrete page before its final PlaceholderPage fallback. This exact path/line/seam/value is non-renderable for the current registry; a route-coverage regression test must fail if a future registered route can reach the fallback.
